scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

worlds.A': observable regime word; regime 1 expects v XOR 1
worlds.B': cue tick then PUT then bare ASK; v XOR 1
worlds.C': lifetime of 16 trials, block 4, cue reliability .7; v XOR 1

genealogy: every generation's population with pid / op / fitness (gzip, plain runs)
crossing: per run: first generation whose best-by-training individual scores >= threshold on 4 held-out sets; a world is CROSSED if >= 2/3 seeds cross (top-4 held-out), PARTIAL if 1/3

separate_readings.A': immediate conditional computation off the identity plateau
separate_readings.B': recruiting existing persistent state for a decision whose cue is gone
